name: Spoonerville
source:
Move into a house with Max and Pj at their old hometown after college. In for a wacky adventure of meeting new faces, finding stable work, love, or just having some fun. This is just a fun fan side project I've been working on for a little bit and respective rights to Disney for the characters. Currently WIP with a few more planned updates.

[From [url=https://jazzinook.itch.io/spoonerville]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
大学毕业后，与Max和Pj一起搬进老家的房子。踏上一段古怪的冒险之旅，结识新面孔、寻找稳定的工作、爱情，或者只是享受一些乐趣。这只是我一直在做的一个有趣的粉丝项目，以及迪士尼对角色的各自权利。目前正在开发中，还有一些计划中的更新。

[来自[url=https://jazzinook.itch.io/spoonerville]Itch.io[/url]]
